question: Select the correct Synonym of '**ENERVATE**'.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Exhaust**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"Enervate"** means to weaken or drain someone of energy, strength, or vitality. (कमज़ोर करना/शक्ति छीन लेना)

 

 
• **Example: **The long and grueling hike enervated even the most experienced trekkers.

 

 

 
• **"Exhaust"** refers to draining someone mentally, emotionally, or physically to the point of extreme fatigue. (थका देना)

 

 
• **Example: **The intense workout left her completely exhausted and in need of rest.

 

 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Enervate' **is **'Exhaust'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Exhaust**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Strengthen **(मज़बूत करना): To make something or someone stronger.

 

 
• **Example:** Regular exercise and a healthy diet can strengthen your immune system.

 

 

 
• **Revive **(पुनर्जीवित करना): To bring something back to life or consciousness.

 

 
• **Example: **The doctor tried to revive the patient after he fainted.

 

 

 
• **Motivate **(प्रेरित करना): To inspire or encourage someone to take action.

 

 
• **Example:** His teacher's praise motivated him to work harder on his studies.

 

 

48:T966,
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
